parameters.command:
python3 -c "
import base64,json,time,urllib.request,urllib.parse,subprocess,tempfile,os,datetime
sa=json.loads(base64.b64decode(os.environ.get('GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_B64','')).decode())
now=int(time.time())
h=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({'alg':'RS256','typ':'JWT'}).encode()).rstrip(b'=').decode()
p=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({'iss':sa['client_email'],'scope':'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.readonly','aud':'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token','exp':now+3600,'iat':now}).encode()).rstrip(b'=').decode()
msg=(h+'.'+p).encode()
kf=tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.pem');mf=tempfile.mktemp()
open(kf,'wb').write(sa['private_key'].encode())
open(mf,'wb').write(msg)
sig=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(subprocess.run(['openssl','dgst','-sha256','-sign',kf,mf],capture_output=True).stdout).rstrip(b'=').decode()
os.unlink(kf);os.unlink(mf)
jwt=h+'.'+p+'.'+sig
data=urllib.parse.urlencode({'grant_type':'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer','assertion':jwt}).encode()
token=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',data=data)).read())['access_token']
sp=os.environ.get('SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID','')
tabs={'bl':os.environ.get('SHEETS_TAB_BLACKLIST','Blacklist_Permanente'),'qu':os.environ.get('SHEETS_TAB_QUARENTENA','Quarentena_90_Dias')}
result={}
for k,t in tabs.items():
    url=f'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/{sp}/values/{urllib.parse.quote(t)}?majorDimension=ROWS'
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'Authorization':f'Bearer {token}'})
    r=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req).read())
    result[k]=[row[0].lower().strip() for row in r.get('values',[])[1:] if row and row[0].strip()]
merged=list(set(result.get('bl',[])+result.get('qu',[])))
print(json.dumps({'blacklist':merged,'count':len(merged),'cachedAt':datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()}))
"
